an5.121:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.121:1.2: atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ patisallānā vuṭṭhito yena gilānasālā tenupasaṅkami.
an5.121:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ.
an5.121:2.1: yaṃ kañci bhikkhave dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ pañca dhammā na vijahanti, tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.121:2.2: na cirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatīti
an5.121:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī, sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī, sabbasaṃkhāresu aniccānupassī, maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
an5.121:3.3: yaṃ kañci bhikkhave dubbalaṃ gilānakaṃ ime pañca dhammā na vijahanti, tassetaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ:
an5.121:3.4: na cirasseva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatīti.
